entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:1
segments: ¶The song of songs, which is Solomon's.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:2
segments: ¶Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth; For thy love is better than wine.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:3
segments: Thine ointments savour sweetly; Thy name is an ointment poured forth: Therefore do the virgins love thee.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:4
segments: Draw me, we will run after thee! --The king hath brought me into his chambers--We will be glad and rejoice in thee, We will remember thy love more than wine. They love thee uprightly.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:5
segments: I am black, but comely, daughters of Jerusalem, As the tents of Kedar, As the curtains of Solomon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:6
segments: Look not upon me, because I am black; Because the sun hath looked upon me. My mother's children were angry with me: They made me keeper of the vineyards; Mine own vineyard have I not kept.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:7
segments: ¶Tell me, thou whom my soul loveth, Where thou feedest [thy flock], Where thou makest it to rest at noon; For why should I be as one veiled Beside the flocks of thy companions?

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:8
segments: If thou know not, thou fairest among women, Go thy way forth by the footsteps of the flock, And feed thy kids beside the shepherds' booths.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:9
segments: I compare thee, my love, To a steed in Pharaoh's chariots.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:10
segments: Thy cheeks are comely with bead-rows, Thy neck with ornamental chains.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:11
segments: We will make thee bead-rows of gold With studs of silver.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:12
segments: ¶While the king is at his table, My spikenard sendeth forth its fragrance.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:13
segments: A bundle of myrrh is my beloved unto me; He shall pass the night between my breasts.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:14
segments: My beloved is unto me a cluster of henna-flowers In the vineyards of Engedi.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:15
segments: Behold, thou art fair, my love; Behold, thou art fair: thine eyes are doves.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:16
segments: Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant; Also our bed is green.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 1:17
segments: The beams of our houses are cedars, Our rafters are cypresses.
